subject.name: Probability and Statistics for Data Science
subject.title: AD-302 - Probability and Statistics for Data Science

Geometric mean, Harmonic Mean and Partition values
Measures of dispersion: Dispersion, Range, Quartile Deviation, Mean deviation
Standard Deviation, Variance and Coefficient of Dispersion

Introduction and definition of Probability
Event, Sample Space

Independent and Dependent events
Bayes' theorem
Mathematical Expectations and Moment generating functions

modules.title: Theoretical Distribution and Curve Fitting
topics: Discrete Distribution - Binomial Distribution and Poisson Distribution
Continuous Distribution – Rectangular and Normal distribution
Curve fitting and Methods of Least square
Fitting a Straight line and a Parabola

modules.title: Correlation and Regression
topics: Correlation, Coefficient of Correlation
Rank Correlation
Lines of Regression
Multiple and Partial Correlation

modules.title: Testing of Hypothesis and Tests of Significance
topics: Null and Alternative hypothesis
Two types of errors, level of significance and power of the test
Chi-square distribution, test of popular variance and test of goodness of fit
t, F, Z distribution and tests based on them
